records.headline: RBI Enhances Transaction Limit for UPI 123Pay and UPI Lite Wallet
records.summary: To further boost digital payment penetration among feature phone users and small-value merchants, Reserve Bank of India raised per-transaction limit for UPI 123Pay from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000, and UPI Lite wallet limit to ₹5,000 with per-transaction cap raised to ₹1,000.
records.exam_fact: UPI 123Pay was launched by RBI & NPCI in March 2022 for 400+ million feature phone users without internet connectivity.
records.why_important: Accelerates financial inclusion in semi-urban and rural areas (Tier-4 to Tier-6 centers).
records.related_static_topic: NPCI payment products (IMPS, UPI, RuPay, AePS, NETC FASTag)
records.related_banking_topic: Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (PSS Act 2007)
records.source: RBI Monetary Policy Statement / Regulatory Notifications

mcqs.question: Which entity operates and manages the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) infrastructure in India?
mcqs.explanation: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), an umbrella organization for retail payment systems founded under PSS Act 2007, manages UPI.

records.headline: World Bank Releases World Development Report 2026: Middle-Income Trap and Clean Transitions
records.summary: The World Bank published its flagship World Development Report focusing on strategies for developing nations to transcend middle-income economic stagnation through the '3i' framework: Investment, Infusion, and Innovation.
records.exam_fact: World Bank Group consists of 5 institutions: IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA, and ICSID. Headquartered in Washington D.C. Ajay Banga is the President.
records.why_important: Guides developing nations like India on escaping the middle-income trap and scaling manufacturing and digital capabilities.
records.related_static_topic: Bretton Woods Conference 1944, IBRD vs IDA (Soft Loan Window)
records.related_banking_topic: External Commercial Borrowings (ECB) and Multilateral Project Financing

mcqs.question: Which arm of the World Bank Group is widely known as the 'Soft Loan Window' for providing concessional zero-interest credits to the world's poorest countries?
options: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)
International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID)
mcqs.explanation: The International Development Association (IDA), established in 1960, is known as the World Bank's 'Soft Loan Window' offering long-term zero or low-interest loans.

records.headline: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) Completes 12 Years: Total Beneficiary Accounts Cross 53 Crore
records.summary: PMJDY marked its 12th anniversary. Official data revealed total accounts crossed 53.5 Crore with over 55% held by women beneficiaries and cumulative deposits exceeding ₹2.35 Lakh Crore.
records.exam_fact: PMJDY was launched nationwide on 28th August 2014 with 6 pillars: Universal banking access, Basic savings bank accounts with RuPay debit card & accident cover of ₹2 Lakh, Overdraft up to ₹10,000, Financial literacy, Credit guarantee fund, and Micro-insurance/pension.
records.why_important: Formed the foundational JAM Trinity (Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile) enabling direct DBT transfers worth trillions.
records.related_static_topic: Financial Inclusion Committees: Nachiket Mor Committee, Khan Committee
records.related_banking_topic: Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA) guidelines issued by RBI
records.source: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance (pib.gov.in)

mcqs.question: What is the maximum overdraft (OD) facility available to eligible PMJDY account holders?
mcqs.explanation: Eligible PMJDY account holders are entitled to an overdraft (OD) facility of up to ₹10,000 (with no conditions asked for OD up to ₹2,000).

records.headline: Prime Minister Addresses Nation from Red Fort on 80th Independence Day: Roadmap for 'Viksit Bharat @2047'
records.summary: On the 80th Independence Day, the PM laid down key economic and social targets including semiconductor self-reliance, green hydrogen energy independence, and creation of 75,000 new medical seats across India.
records.exam_fact: India targets becoming a developed nation ('Viksit Bharat') by 2047, the centenary of India's independence.
records.why_important: Sets policy priorities for infrastructure, domestic manufacturing, and high-tech capital goods.
records.related_static_topic: National Symbols of India (National Flag, Anthem, Song, Emblem) & Constitutional History
records.related_banking_topic: Capital expenditure loans to states for capex creation

mcqs.question: The constitutional target year designated for achieving 'Viksit Bharat' (Developed Nation status for India) is:
mcqs.explanation: 'Viksit Bharat @2047' represents the Government of India's comprehensive vision to transform India into a developed nation by the centenary year of independence (2047).

records.headline: India Launches First National Supercomputing Mission High-Performance Cluster 'PARAM Rudra'
records.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and C-DAC deployed three new indigenously designed 'PARAM Rudra' supercomputing systems at Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (Pune), Inter-University Accelerator Centre (Delhi), and S.N. Bose National Centre (Kolkata).
records.exam_fact: C-DAC (Centre for Development of Advanced Computing) developed India's first indigenous supercomputer 'PARAM 8000' in 1991 led by Dr. Vijay Bhatkar.
records.why_important: Empowers astrophysics research, atomic material simulations, and weather forecasting algorithms.
records.related_static_topic: Supercomputing in India, C-DAC, Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (GMRT)
records.related_banking_topic: Cybersecurity frameworks for core banking solution (CBS) infrastructure

mcqs.question: India's first indigenous supercomputer, PARAM 8000, was developed in 1991 by which institution?
mcqs.explanation: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) built India's first supercomputer PARAM 8000 in 1991.

records.headline: RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) Keeps Repo Rate Unchanged at 6.50% with Focus on 'Withdrawal of Accommodation'
records.summary: The six-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of RBI voted with a 4:2 majority to keep the benchmark policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50%, retaining vigilance on food inflation while projecting FY27 real GDP growth at 7.2%.
records.exam_fact: Under Section 45ZB of RBI Act 1934, MPC comprises 6 members: 3 from RBI (Governor as Ex-officio Chair, Deputy Governor in-charge of MP, and one officer) and 3 external members appointed by the Central Government. Inflation target is 4% with a tolerance band of +/- 2% (2% to 6%).
records.why_important: Determines interest rate benchmark for floating-rate home loans, personal loans, and banking deposit rates.
records.related_static_topic: Monetary Policy instruments (Repo, Reverse Repo, SDF, MSF, CRR, SLR)
records.related_banking_topic: External Benchmark Lending Rate (EBLR) linked to RBI Repo Rate
records.source: Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Statement

mcqs.question: Under the Flexible Inflation Targeting (FIT) framework established under the RBI Act, what is the mandated consumer inflation target band?
mcqs.explanation: Under Section 45ZA of the RBI Act 1934, the Central Government in consultation with RBI has set the consumer inflation target at 4% with a tolerance band of +/- 2% (i.e. 2% to 6%).

records.headline: Indian Air Force Participates in Multilateral Air Exercise 'Tarang Shakti 2026'
records.summary: The Indian Air Force hosted 'Tarang Shakti', one of the largest multilateral air combat exercises in South Asia, at Suringar/Jodhpur featuring fighter jets and observers from over 15 partner nations including France, Germany, USA, and UK.
records.exam_fact: Tarang Shakti is India's first indigenous multinational air exercise. Rafale, Su-30MKI, LCA Tejas, and Mirage 2000 participated.
records.why_important: Demonstrates IAF's interoperability and power projection across the Indo-Pacific theatre.
records.related_static_topic: Important Joint Military Exercises of India (Garuda, Varuna, Yudh Abhyas, Malabar, Mitra Shakti)
records.related_banking_topic: Defence procurement offset policies and domestic aerospace MSMEs

mcqs.question: 'Tarang Shakti' is a major multilateral military exercise hosted by which branch of the Indian Armed Forces?
mcqs.explanation: Tarang Shakti is the largest multilateral air combat exercise organized and hosted by the Indian Air Force.

records.headline: Project Tiger and Project Elephant Joint Review: India's Tiger Population Estimated at 3,682
records.summary: The National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) and Wildlife Institute of India (WII) released updated status report confirming India hosts 75% of the world's wild tiger population, with Madhya Pradesh retaining the 'Tiger State' title with 785 tigers.
records.exam_fact: Project Tiger was launched on 1st April 1973 at Corbett National Park, Uttarakhand. International Tiger Day is celebrated on 29th July annually.
records.why_important: Validates apex predator conservation and habitat restoration across 55+ designated Tiger Reserves.
records.related_static_topic: Tiger Reserves of India, NTCA (Statutory body under Wildlife Protection Act 1972)
records.related_banking_topic: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funding for biodiversity conservation

mcqs.question: Which state in India currently hosts the highest number of wild tigers according to NTCA census reports?
mcqs.explanation: Madhya Pradesh has the highest number of wild tigers (785 tigers), closely followed by Karnataka (563 tigers).

records.headline: Justice Sanjiv Khanna Appointed as Chairperson of National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
records.summary: In accordance with tradition under the Legal Services Authorities Act 1987, the senior-most puisne judge of the Supreme Court was nominated as the Executive Chairman of NALSA.
records.exam_fact: Chief Justice of India is the Patron-in-Chief of NALSA. Free legal aid is guaranteed under Article 39A (Directive Principles of State Policy) inserted via the 42nd Amendment Act 1976.
records.why_important: Guarantees free, competent legal representation to marginalized citizens and organizes nationwide Lok Adalats.
records.related_static_topic: Article 39A (Equal Justice & Free Legal Aid), Supreme Court of India, Legal Services Authorities Act 1987
records.related_banking_topic: Lok Adalats for speedy recovery of non-performing assets (NPAs) up to ₹20 Lakh

mcqs.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution directs the State to provide free legal aid to ensure equal justice for poor citizens?
mcqs.explanation: Article 39A (inserted by the 42nd Amendment in 1976) obligates the state to provide free legal aid by suitable legislation or schemes.

records.headline: UNDP Releases Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI): 415 Million Indians Exited Poverty in 15 Years
records.summary: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI) reported India's historic achievement of lifting 415 million people out of multidimensional poverty between 2005-06 and 2019-21.
records.exam_fact: Global MPI evaluates poverty across 3 dimensions (Health, Education, Standard of living) and 10 indicators (Nutrition, Child mortality, Years of schooling, Attendance, Cooking fuel, Sanitation, Drinking water, Electricity, Housing, Assets).
records.why_important: Proves substantial socioeconomic mobility through basic amenity saturation (water, sanitation, electricity, LPG).
records.related_static_topic: UNDP (HQ New York), Human Development Index (HDI), Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)
records.related_banking_topic: Priority sector credit impact on living standards and household micro-assets

mcqs.question: The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) assesses poverty across how many core dimensions?
mcqs.explanation: Global MPI measures poverty across three equally-weighted dimensions: Health, Education, and Standard of Living (subdivided into 10 indicators).
